processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 30 kg ingot produced by vacuum induction melting; sound portion used for downstream processing.
Final hot rolled plate thickness about 13 mm; hot rolling details reported elsewhere [21].

processing_steps.method: cold rolling at room temperature (several passes)
processing_steps.reduction_ratio: ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 15Mn5Ni alloy experienced cracking beyond 50% cold reduction, hence reduction was restricted to 50% for all alloys for comparison.

processing_steps.method: heat treatment (annealing) of cold rolled sheet
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Part of the two-phase-region heat-treatment series 873–1273 K, 1 h, water quench; produces concurrent κ-carbide/B2 precipitation with recrystallization.

structures.overall_structure: Precursor HR+CR (50% cold reduced) state of 15Mn5Ni: two-phase γ + B2 microstructure with banded/elongated austenite deformed mostly by planar slip and abundant elongated B2 stringers; no deformation twinning or martensite.

microstructure_list.region: banded/elongated austenite matrix aligned with ND

phases_present.morphology: elongated, banded grains; deformed mostly by planar slip with parallel slip bands

microstructure_list.region: elongated B2 stringers within the γ matrix

phases_present.morphology: elongated stringers (bamboo-like), sheared and fragmented at ~35–45° to rolling direction

precipitates.size: ~2 μm (average thickness reduced from ~8 μm by cold rolling)
precipitates.distribution: elongated stringers in the γ matrix

structures.overall_structure: HR+CR+973 K 15Mn5Ni: mixed deformed and recrystallized austenite with concurrent κ-carbide and B2 precipitation on a banded γ + B2-stringer framework; the austenite is heavily deformed and largely unindexed in EBSD with only scattered elongated recrystallized grains, giving near-zero recrystallization fraction.

phases_present.volume_fraction: recrystallization fraction near zero at 973 K

precipitates.size: fine, uniformly distributed (no numeric value given)

phases_present.morphology: heavily deformed, largely unindexed (unresolved) in EBSD

defects.type: deformed austenite with dislocation substructure (heavily strained, unindexed)

precipitates.distribution: inhomogeneous, relatively coarse; size higher in 15Mn5Ni than in 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni; decorating deformation bands

phases_present.morphology: elongated stringers + fine intragranular particles + coarser intergranular particles; coarser B2 precipitate-rich zone around deformed austenite

precipitates.type: B2 stringer (prior phase remaining after heat treatment)
precipitates.size: stringer morphology (no numeric value given for 973 K state)
precipitates.distribution: elongated stringers dispersed through γ matrix in banded pattern

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip; the austenite grains deformed mostly by planar slip; non-shearable B2 particles act as obstacles to dislocation motion and cause early initiation of slip band refinement; inhomogeneous slip band spacing in Ni-containing LDS.
interfaces.phase_evolution: On heat treatment at 973 K additional XRD peaks of κ-carbides and B2 appear in 15Mn5Ni (compared with cold rolled condition), and B2 peaks are more intense at 973 K than at 1173 K; B2 volume fraction decreases from ~40% at 973 K to ~15% at 1173 K as finer B2 dissolves faster than stringers.
interfaces.interface_notes: Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interface; intragranular B2 particles do not pin newly recrystallized grains but may delay recovery.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimen, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1; tests triplicated and average reported

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Stress–strain curves of 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K (and 1023 K) could not be recorded because the alloy behaved like a brittle material with tensile elongation <1%.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford); TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: step size 120 nm (fine-grained) and 250 nm (coarse-grained) over ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm²; three scans per sample; samples polished to ~100 nm colloidal silica
characterization_methods.purpose: grain orientations, grain size, twin fraction, recrystallization fraction via KAM and GOS <2°, and phase contrast maps
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni at 973 K is heavily deformed/unindexed with dense B2 stringers; recrystallization fraction near zero; grain size of recrystallized austenite a few μm; higher B2 fraction than the other alloys.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument, Co-Kα radiation at 45 kV and 135 mA, beam size ~2 mm
characterization_methods.purpose: phase identification (γ, B2, κ-carbide) in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni cold rolled showed γ+B2 peaks; after 973 K heat treatment additional κ-carbide and B2 peaks appeared; B2 peaks more intense at 973 K than at 1173 K.

characterization_methods.technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM, bright-field and dark-field) with SAED and EDS
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 TEM operating at 200 kV equipped with EDAX EDS; twin-jet electropolished in mixed acid at 243 K
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: SAED patterns ZA[101]; dark-field from (010)κ satellite spot; scale bars 500 nm (and 1 μm)
characterization_methods.purpose: characterize deformed/recrystallized austenite and finer phases (κ-carbides, B2 particles) not resolvable by EBSD
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni-973 K contains fine intragranular B2 (5–20 nm), intergranular B2 (50–200 nm) and κ-carbides; coarse κ-carbides (10–60 nm) in deformed austenite, larger than in 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s; average of ten measurements
characterization_methods.purpose: evaluate change in mechanical properties upon cold working and heat treatment
characterization_methods.key_findings: No numeric hardness value reported for 15Mn5Ni in the HR+CR+973 K condition; Ni-containing alloys were significantly harder than 28Mn0Ni at any given heat-treatment temperature and hardness decreased with increasing temperature.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: ASTM E8M; flat specimens gauge 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm; cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (~3×10^-4 s^-1); triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: evaluate strength and ductility of the alloys in different processing conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni heat treated at 973 K (and 1023 K) behaved brittly with tensile elongation <1% and no response curve could be recorded.

unmapped_findings: The processing temperature window for 15Mn5Ni alloy was found to be around 1173 K; upon heat treatment at 973 K and 1023 K this alloy displayed very low ductility (<1%), attributed to the presence of a large volume fraction of B2 particles and co-precipitation of coarser κ-carbides and B2 along grain boundaries.
Volume fraction of B2 particles in 15Mn5Ni decreased drastically from ~40% at 973 K to ~15% at 1173 K, whereas in hot rolled condition the prior B2 fraction was ~12%.

XRD of 15Mn5Ni after heat treatment at 973 K showed additional peaks corresponding to κ-carbides and B2 relative to the cold rolled condition, and the B2 diffraction peaks were more intense at 973 K than at 1173 K, indicating a higher volume fraction of secondary phases at lower annealing temperature.

Bulk Vickers hardness of 15Mn5Ni in the HR+CR+973 K condition is not reported numerically; the Ni-containing alloys (28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni) had significantly higher hardness than the 28Mn0Ni alloy at any given heat-treatment temperature and their hardness decreased monotonically with increasing heat-treatment temperature, increasing to ~500 VHN upon heat treatment at 873 K.

TEM-EDS composition of the B2 phase in 15Mn5Ni was reported only for the 1173 K condition (Mn 10.5–8.7 wt.%, Al 12.8–13.5 wt.%, Ni 20.2–22.0 wt.%; correspondingly Mn 9.5–7.8 at.%, Al 23.5–24.6 at.%, Ni 17.0–18.5 at.%), and not for the 973 K condition; the B2 phase was identified as an FeAl based phase containing significant Mn and Ni.

A prominent coarser B2 precipitate-rich zone formed around deformed austenite in 15Mn5Ni alloy during heat treatment at 973 K, whereas in 28Mn5Ni fine secondary B2 was precipitated mostly along grain boundaries.
The size of κ-carbides in deformed austenite regions of 15Mn5Ni was higher than in 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni alloys under the same 973 K heat-treatment condition.

All three alloys (including 15Mn5Ni) attained similar strength levels (~450 VHN hardness) after 50% cold reduction; the strength of 50% cold rolled alloys increased to ~1.4–1.8 GPa at the expense of ductility.

At the HR+CR (50% cold reduction) condition 15Mn5Ni exhibited YS 1665 ± 12 MPa, UTS 1800 ± 15 MPa and total elongation 7 ± 0.5% (this is the precursor cold-rolled state, not the 973 K heat-treated state of this sample).
